description: Before acting on a website for a user, check whether it lets AI agents browse, shop, book or log in, and whether there's an official agent route (UCP, ACP, MCP, Visa TAP, A2A, partner apps). Returns status (open|partial|announced|none, or unknown if we have no verified record), recommended_action (a suggestion based on public sources, not permission; the website's own terms always take priority), per-action allowances, routes, dated sources. Read-only.

domain.description: Domain or URL, e.g. delta.com or https://www.delta.com/flights

name: check_domain
title: Check a website's AI-agent policy
